tours.overview: A 4-night wildlife photography field workshop at Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve in Maharashtra, focused on wildlife photography, field techniques, and post-processing. The workshop is crafted by a naturalist and led by a photographer, with 7 game drives and a maximum of 7 seats. The trip operates ex-Nagpur and includes accommodation, meals, safari charges, transfers, and learning sessions.

itinerary.title: Arrival, Orientation & First Safari
itinerary.description: Pickup from Nagpur at 09:30 followed by a drive to Kolara. Check-in at the lodge, trip orientation, and lunch followed by afternoon safari. Review session in the evening.

itinerary.title: Morning & Afternoon Safaris
itinerary.description: Morning safari, Breakfast carried in jeep. Lunch followed by afternoon safari. Safari timings are subject to forest department notifications or weather conditions. Review session in the evening.

itinerary.title: Morning & Afternoon Safaris
itinerary.description: Morning safari, Breakfast carried in jeep. Lunch followed by afternoon safari. Early reporting is followed to experience the serenity and sudden surprises also to avoid dust. Review session in the evening.

itinerary.title: Somnath Buffer Zone Safaris
itinerary.description: Morning safari at Somnath Buffer Zone followed by an afternoon safari at Somnath Buffer Zone. The afternoon departure may be adjusted depending on morning wildlife movement and expected sightings.

itinerary.title: Workshop Closure & Departure
itinerary.description: Workshop closure and breakfast at 08:00, followed by departure for Nagpur at 09:45. Dispersal at Nagpur at approximately 12:30.

tours.accommodation: Standard jungle lodge accommodation located approximately 350 meters from the nearest safari entry gate. Rooms are air-conditioned with attached toilets, geysers, electric kettles, and standard amenities. Rooms are allotted on a double-occupancy basis. Basic toiletries including bath towels, soap, and shampoo are provided. Individual rooms may not have Wi-Fi, while the common restaurant area has Wi-Fi.
tours.meals: Morning tea or coffee is self-service in the rooms using electric kettles and provided Darjeeling tea bags. Breakfast is carried in the jeep and served in the jungle, with timing depending on activities going on in the jungle. Vegetarian lunch is served at the restaurant from approximately 12:30 to 13:00. Evening high tea includes tea or coffee with Indian vegetarian snacks after the afternoon game drive. Dinner is served at the restaurant from approximately 21:15 to 21:45 and includes chicken as the non-vegetarian option. Meals mainly consist of local dishes such as rice, roti, dal, sabji, and curry items. RO drinking water is provided in rooms and during safaris.
tours.transportation: Guests are picked up from Nagpur at 09:30 and transported to Kolara using a compact AC SUV or MUV. All safari transfers are conducted using jeeps or SUVs depending on distance. The return journey to Nagpur begins at 09:45 on the final day, with dispersal at approximately 12:30. All Nagpur-to-Nagpur and safari gate transfers are included.
thingsToCarry: Sunscreen lotion and sun protection gear
Bandana or face mask for dust
Thin towel or light cover to protect camera or binoculars from dust
Laptop or HDD for additional storage if required
importantNotes: The workshop takes place at Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve in Maharashtra, with Nagpur as the nearest airport and transfer point.
Trip dates are 18th to 22nd January 2027, covering 4 nights and 5 days.
The workshop includes 7 game drives across 3 different zones.
The group is limited to 7 seats.
Game drives generally run from 06:30 to 10:30 in the morning and 14:00 to 18:00 in the afternoon, subject to weather and Forest Department notifications.
Morning safari reporting is at 05:45 on 19th and 20th January and 05:15 on 21st January at the lodge parking area.
Afternoon safari reporting is at 14:15 from 18th to 20th January and 13:20 on 21st January.
Mobile phones are not allowed inside the park and should be left at the lodge.
A hard-copy National ID proof is required for every game drive and will be checked at the safari entry gate.
Plastic bottles are not allowed in the park. Purified drinking water is provided at the lodge and during safaris.
January is expected to be cold, dry, and dusty, so warm layers, windproof jackets, sunglasses, and dust protection are recommended.
Photography learning sessions cover understanding the subject and landscape, understanding the camera device, field techniques, different light conditions, composition, and basic post-processing.
Recommended equipment includes a full-frame or crop-sensor DSLR, a 250mm or longer telephoto lens, a wide-angle lens for landscapes, spare batteries, and spare memory cards.
Specific medical or dietary requirements should be communicated in advance.
Participants are advised to carry basic cash and emergency medicines as medical and ATM facilities may not be easily available nearby.
Any deviation from park rules by an individual may result in cancellation of safaris for the entire group.
Total cost is INR 42,000 per person, ex-Nagpur and all-inclusive.
